problem_statement: During a TCAT session, when a TCAT Commissioner decommissions a device (which clears the Active Operational Dataset), the Commissioner should regain the ability to write or overwrite the Active Dataset again within the same session so that repeated commission/decommission cycles work. Currently, after such a Decommission the Commissioner is no longer authorized to set the Active Dataset, so a recommission attempt is rejected. In addition, repeated Start/Stop of the Thread interface while it is already started/stopped should succeed idempotently without re-invoking the join/leave callback, a Set Active Dataset operation must require the Thread interface to be stopped, and a dataset change caused by another process (e.g. a changed network key or Extended PAN ID) must revoke the Commissioner's authorization to overwrite the dataset, while a change the agent itself made must not.
